To me, 3-Drive is like a compression,or more so, like stack zones. 3 drives normally signifies the end is near and we are likely to get a reversal, especially if it is driving directly to the potential level. Many retailers are taught to look for this pattern at turning points. But what you should focus more on is, is the 3-drive happening (driving up) to important levels we here price is likely to reverse. At that level, then you look for PA and not blindly entering expecting a reversal, because without PA you are gambling
